component.name: Herbarium
component.summary: Reader for the HTML pages AI tools generate

description.p: Herbarium is a desktop reader for the HTML pages AI tools generate. Save a page, find it later, open it with its interactivity intact, and schedule it for review so it comes back when you need it.

Pages stay plain .html files in a folder you own, with a small JSON sidecar for titles, tags, notes and review dates. Every page runs in a sandbox that cannot reach your files, the app or other pages; network access is a per-page switch.
Includes full-text search, folders and tags, a keyboard-driven review session, a command palette, light and dark themes, and an English and French interface.

description.p: Pages now keep their own state across reloads, in-app edits have a version history with a diff view, an `herbarium add` CLI and herbarium-app:// deep links, and review scheduling is adaptive.
